modules.module_title: Prepare for testing

pcs.pc_description: identify the testing process of the entire setup based on the documents provided by the respective OEM and consultant
identify the operating conditions and functioning of each of the equipment

modules.module_title: Inspect electric power supply and air conditioning

pcs.pc_description: inspect all electric, audio, RF and data connectivity
verify that polarity for the hot (positive/red), cold (negative/black) and ground (green) points for audio are connected as per the standard practice
test to ensure that power supply line, Neutral and Earth are connected as per the standard practice
monitor and log the power supply voltage and current drawn by all the major equipment using multimeter and clip-on ammeter
test and log the AC voltage between Neutral and Earth of incoming supply, distribution board and every point socket
examine earth connectivity in case AC voltage is more than 1 V
inspect the balancing of electric power loads on all the three phases
measure and log the air flow, outdoor and indoor temperatures and relative humidity to ascertain optimum working of air conditioning

modules.module_title: Test audio / IT equipment and RF equipment

pcs.pc_description: assist the Radio Broadcast engineer test the condition and functionality of the equipment across all important parameters such as THD, SNR, response, insertion loss, etc.

assist the Radio Broadcast Engineer in the measurement and documentation (logging) of all vital parameters in the audio/RF equipment like return loss of the combined feeder cable/antenna during cold condition and forward/reflected power during the operating condition of the transmitter and transfer switch, etc.
prepare log of important parameters displayed by the transmitter's front panel for reference

modules.module_title: Prepare for commissioning and hands-on training

pcs.pc_description: check the entire system visually to ensure its normal performance
arrange for listening tests of the chain and final broadcast
organise hands-on training for the station staff based on the operation and maintenance of the setup

modules.module_title: Prepare for installation

pcs.pc_description: identify the workflow of the entire broadcast chain and facility
analyse the floor plan of studio and transmitter station site
interpret the content of technical and installation manual of all equipment to be installed
select the best suitable area for placement of power supply equipment, systems and other equipment in studio and transmitter station site
mark the placement of ventilation and air conditioning equipment at the studio and transmitter centre
plan the placement of server rack, cable harness, etc. at the studio and transmitter centre

modules.module_title: Perform laying of cable trays, cables, raceways and conduits

pcs.pc_description: mark the position for equipment and cable routing on the floor and wall at studio and transmitter station centre
install raceways, cable trays and conduiting work as per the drawing for electrical power wires/cables for both the centres
install conduits as per the drawing for routing the audio and networking cables for both the centre
install cable trays/raceways/wall support structure as per the drawing for laying the rigid lines, RF feeder cables etc. at the transmitter centre
perform laying and termination of all the cables with appropriate sized lugs, ferrules, etc. as per the installation manual at both the centres

modules.module_title: Fix connectors and terminate cables

pcs.pc_description: prepare connection for power supply cables as per the installation manual
fix connectors and terminate microphone cables, audio cables, data cables and RF rigid lines / cables as per the installation manual
plan laying and routing of microphone cables for interconnecting the audio equipment
perform labelling of all microphone cables using standard notation and legends
verify polarity of audio connectors in conformity with standard notation
perform sealing of conduit ends using approved material/device

modules.module_title: Install equipment and software at studio

pcs.pc_description: prepare a plan for installation of LT distribution kiosk, cabling, earthing and other LT power supply works
provide UPS back up power connection to all equipment as per the consultant’s drawing
install and wire the audio equipment, computer, studio transmitter link equipment and network-enabled devices like mixers, telephone hybrid, etc.
follow appropriate procedure to securely connect earth wires with the equipment
install studio automation software for recording, postproduction, playlist creation, playback and archiving functions

modules.module_title: Install equipment and software at transmission centre

pcs.pc_description: prepare a plan for installing LT distribution kiosk, cabling, earthing and doing other LT power supply works
provide UPS back up power connection to all equipment as per the OEM’s recommendation
plan for positioning the transmitter, coaxial switch, RF rigid line feeders, UPS, LT switchgear, etc. on the floor as per the installation manual
install RF rigid line from transmitter/RF change over output to the outdoor coaxial feeder cable through a wall feed using an insulator at the FM transmitter site
install the transmission line (feeder line) from the wall through an insulator (transmitter) to the ATU at the AM transmitter site
install cable dehydrator and the associated plumbing for the outdoor coaxial feeder cable at FM transmitter site
install and wire the broadcast processor, the codec for the STL link, the transmitter (along with standby transmitter, if provided), the RF change over switch and dummy load
install and wire the AM/FM demodulator, remote monitoring equipment and monitoring equipment as per the installation manual
verify that the earth strips are securely connected to high power equipment viz. UPS and AM/FM transmitter
install the indoor RF rigid lines/transmission lines at the transmitter centre for interconnecting transmitter, combiner and feeder cable

modules.module_title: Install electric power supply

pcs.pc_description: implement the plan of electrical installation for interconnecting ESCOM incoming supply, captive power source, main distribution board, UPS, switch boards for lighting, equipment and general purpose power points
install UPS system and power distribution as per recommended procedures and drawings
route electric wires in conduits for the luminaries over the false ceiling
label all cables as per the drawing for ease of identification
seal conduits with glass wool buds to prevent sound leakage and ingress of insects

modules.module_title: Work as per the organisational team environment

pcs.pc_description: identify team objectives and goals, team members by name, their role and responsibilities, greet them appropriately and respond to their greetings
comply with organisation’s policies and procedures for working with team members within and outside the organisation—especially related to privacy, confidentiality and security
work as per the environment to build trust and mutual respect
participate in decision making by providing facts and figures, give / accept constructive suggestions, take initiatives to help team members arrive at workable decisions and meet the goals
accept decisions professionally and support even if they do not match suggestions and personal views

modules.module_title: Communicate effectively

pcs.pc_description: communicate professionally as per organisation's protocols, using appropriate mode of communication—verbal, written, mail, phone or text—and clearly articulate the message to ensure that the receiver understands the message
listen to team members attentively, respond promptly, seek / provide clarifications if required
share important information with the team timely and refrain from overloading them with unnecessary and unsolicited information

modules.module_title: Co-operate with team members and superiors

pcs.pc_description: perform own role, receive inputs from others and make adjustments within permissible rules as per requirement, to produce output in time for other team members to follow

help team members to perform their role effectively and provide any clarifications/support they need, including tools /equipment / common resources as well as resolve any contentious issues amicably, involving the team lead or the supervisor if needed
let team members know in good time if commitments cannot be carried out, explaining the reasons, and provide alternate solutions, if any; let the team lead know about this

act in the interest of the team and the organisation, take initiative to correct the wrong, seek help or escalate if needed to ensure that things do not ‘fall through the gap’ and team goals are achieved

modules.module_title: Respect customs / preferences and gender / ability differences

pcs.pc_description: follow organisation’s policies and statutory guidelines w.r.t seeking information about others' customs / preferences, making references or comments on social customs / preferences, and refrain from hurting sentiments
accommodate team members’ preferences to the extent feasible, and in case they come in the way of fulfilling team goals, discuss with the supervisor/ team leader
ensure personal behaviour, conduct and communication styles, taking gender and disability of the person into consideration
list the different types of disabilities with their respective issues and ways to help them overcome challenges
use inclusive language, verbal as well as non- verbal, irrespective of the disability and the gender of the person
ensure equal treatment for all clients, colleagues and co-workers while respecting their personal space

modules.module_title: Adhere to standard safety procedures of the company

pcs.pc_description: comply with general safety procedures and those for handling an equipment, hazardous material or tool, followed in the company
remove finger rings or any other metal objects likely to interfere with the work before working on the unit
use of safety materials such as goggles, gloves, ear plugs, caps, ESD pins, covers, shoes, etc.
escalate the issue about hazardous materials or things found in the premises or any breach of safety procedure in the company
ensure zero accidents at work
avoid damage of components due to negligence in ESD procedures or any other loss due to safety negligence
participate regularly in fire drills or other safety related workshops organised by the company

modules.module_title: Maintain good health and posture

pcs.pc_description: maintain appropriate posture, especially in long hours of sitting or standing position and in handling heavy materials
participate in company organised health sessions such as yoga, physiotherapy or games
handle heavy and hazardous materials with care, while maintaining appropriate posture, using suitable tools and handling equipment such as trolleys, jacks and ladders

modules.module_title: Effective waste management/recycling practices

pcs.pc_description: identify recyclable and non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated to be segregated accordingly
dispose non-recyclable waste and hazardous waste as per recommended processes
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified location

modules.module_title: Adopt learning and self-direction

pcs.pc_description: understand importance of skill advancement and develop mastery
adapt product / service to meet success criteria
understand accountability for timely completion of tasks
manage to express emotions in appropriate ways at workplace and understand the cause for the emotions

modules.module_title: Develop system thinking in problem solving

pcs.pc_description: analyse the problem accurately and communicate different possible solutions to the problem
manage to estimate the cause of the problem and validate

modules.module_title: Material/Resources conservation practices

pcs.pc_description: identify ways to optimize usage of material including water and electricity / energy in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes and plug them or escalate to appropriate authority
carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines and equipment

check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required and report malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) or any lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use
